subject: Next steps: Qualification recap & POC commitment for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@meridianhealth.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Sep 10, 2026 at 15:12 PDT
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed 30-day POC for Meridian Health

Hi Sanjay / Laura —

Thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC. Short version at the top: we heard operational triage of inbound patient messages (Triage Q->A + routing) is the highest priority, and you agreed a 30-day POC to validate throughput, precision on intent classification, and safe-handling of PHI is the right next step.

Key pain points you shared:
- Manual inbox triage taking 5–8 FTEs and delayed response times during peaks
- Frequent misrouted messages (billing vs clinical) causing downstream SLA misses
- Need for auditable decisions and redaction before any PHI leaves your environment

POC scope (proposed) — 30 days:
- Model: small ensemble (open model + classifier) served via Redwood Dedicated in your VPC
- Workload: 5k messages/day simulated (with live ramp if procurement clears)
- Success metrics: intent classification accuracy >= 88% on curated prompt set; routing precision >= 90% for top-3 buckets; median end-to-end latency <= 400ms for classification path
- Safety: prefix-KV redaction + customer-managed KMS for keys; we will provide an audit log feed to your SIEM

Owners & roles:
- Meridian: Sanjay (technical owner), Laura (project sponsor), Procurement (contracts)
- Redwood: Rachel (sales/po), Ben (solutions/infra), Hannah (onboarding ops)

Access & setup checklist (items you agreed to):
1) Provide a read-only S3 bucket with anonymized sample messages (or signed attestation if full PHI cannot be shared) — Sanjay/Laura
2) Ok to run an initial 2k-message synthetic run while procurement finalizes the SOW — Meridian
3) Add procurement contact for contract and DPA review — Procurement
4) Provide list of top-6 routing buckets + sample labels for prompt tuning — Meridian

Attachments: meridian-poc-charter-v1.pdf (charter & success criteria), sample-prompt-set.csv (initial prompts + expected labels).

Proposed timeline:
- 9/17: finalize SOW & security addenda (DocuSign link in related links)
- 9/21: infra provisioning + access exchange
- 9/22–10/21: 30-day POC (runs + prompt tuning + weekly checkpoints)

Can we confirm by EOD Monday (9/13) that procurement will accept the SOW milestone schedule? If yes, Ben and I will start provisioning templates and a security packet for your team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel —

Quick acknowledgement from our side. High level we like the scope; a couple of clarifying points before procurement will move: 
1) Security: can you confirm if KMS will be customer-managed HSM or if Redwood-managed keys are necessary for initial runs? We need the option for customer KMS in our VPC.

3) Data: we will start with anonymized data; can you confirm the redaction approach so we can run an internal privacy review?

Laura — can you confirm procurement availability to review SOW on Monday?

Hi Sanjay —

Short answers: customer-managed KMS in your VPC is supported and is our recommendation for the production path. For the POC we can operate in two modes:
A) Isolated POC in your VPC with customer-managed KMS (preferred, slightly longer setup time)
B) Redwood-hosted sandbox with strict redaction and scoped telemetry (faster to start, limited to anonymized data)

Audit logs: we will deliver JSONL logs to a dedicated S3 prefix. We can configure lifecycle/retention to 90 days and provide signed manifests daily. I attached a short security FAQ that covers the redaction approach, KMS options, and typical retention policies.

If procurement needs minimal SOW changes we can accept a 2-business-day turn on the DPA after initial redlines. If you want, Rachel and I can join your procurement call Monday — we have availability at 10:00am or 3:00pm ET.

Actions from Redwood:
- Ben: share security-FAQ.pdf + onboarding-runbook (attached)
- Rachel: send final SOW with milestone dates and DocuSign link once procurement confirms

Attachments: security-FAQ.pdf, onboarding-runbook.pdf, MVP-prompt-examples.csv

Thanks —
